steps.name: select fighters
steps.action: Versus > click Goku > Confirm > click Frieza > Confirm
steps.assertion: match created with Goku (P1) vs Frieza (CPU), both 1000 HP

steps.name: move and attack
steps.action: hold W, press J x6, K, L (keyboard)
steps.assertion: player position changes, CPU HP drops only on connecting hits; special cooldown starts

steps.name: block / dodge / jump
steps.assertion: state enters block/dodge; blocked hits deal reduced damage (blockstun)

steps.name: match resolves by real KO
steps.action: fight continues until a fighter reaches 0 HP
steps.assertion: match stops, KO announced, DEFEAT/WIN result with correct winner and HP 0 for loser

steps.name: rematch
steps.assertion: new match, both fighters back at 1000 HP

steps.name: arcade progression
steps.action: Arcade > Naruto > Fight until win > Continue

steps.name: tournament to champion
steps.action: Tournament > Gogeta > win QF, SF, Final
steps.assertion: bracket advances only on real wins; CPU-vs-CPU matches decided by headless engine bouts; champion screen

steps.name: engine round-robin
steps.action: node qa/tests/sim-roundrobin.mjs (all 240 pairings, every special vs dummy)
steps.assertion: 240/240 bouts end by KO; every special lands damage and sets cooldown
